title: queue microbenchmarks without an executor
question: enqueue and dequeue cost with nothing draining
conclusions: In Queue Only Operations, enqueue and dequeue (100 cycles per iteration, fresh queue) is 2.01x slower than enqueue job (100 per iteration, fresh queue)
In Queue Size Query, queue total size (500 jobs across 10 sub-queues) ran at 9247157.25 ops/sec
In Queue Profiling Extensions, mixed payload sizes with dequeueNext is 1.19x slower than rapid-fire enqueue across documents (disparate payloads)
In Queue Hint DAG Resolution, queue hint dynamic nested DAG resolution is 348.7x slower than queue hint complex DAG resolution
caveats: The two DAG cases enqueue dependents before their dependencies across sub-queues — valid per the queue contract, but not a shape any reactor producer emits, since executeBatch and loadBatch topologically sort first
